reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "For soccer, I like a short general warm-up first - easy jog or bike for a few minutes - then into movement prep: glute bridges, lateral band walks, and some controlled single-leg work like step-downs to wake up the hips and quads. Add in some multi-directional stuff before you touch a ball: cutting drills, deceleration work, and landing mechanics from a small hop, focusing on soft knees and a strong hip position. The ACL loves good landing control, so slow it down before you speed it up. Want me to build this into your program as a standing warm-up?"}
